ko.title: 유럽 항공기 폭파 협박 최소 15편 비상착륙·회항…‘하이브리드전’ 우려

en.title: Bomb threats force at least 15 European flights to land or turn back, stoking ‘hybrid warfare’ fears
en.summary: The Guardian reported that new bomb threats, following a false alarm two days earlier, led to more emergency landings and diversions.

zh.title: 欧洲航班炸弹威胁致至少15架次紧急降落或返航,“混合战”担忧升温
